Metadata.benchmark.Contract: Full four-field public reader scan; setup validates every field, count/checksum and decoded input parity. Indexed controls emit a known dimension.
Metadata.benchmark.AllocationScope: Read records process-wide managed allocations. HeldMemory records calling-thread allocations, excluding the sampler worker.
Metadata.benchmark.MemoryLimits: HeldMemory timings include explicit GC and sampling and do not measure throughput. Sampled peaks are lower bounds; retained managed bytes are measured after GC while the enumerator remains held.
